static_traits.name: Chen Siying
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, living with a cat; Mother was a Nurse
static_traits.social_status: Having a few casual acquaintances at Work, no relatives, friends or close confidants nearby to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: Never received psychotherapy in the past, no significant physical illness; similar Loneliness and isolation appeared after high-pressure or major events
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly describe events and feelings, with noticeable catastrophizing and future prediction, overgeneralization and other negative Automatic thoughts; self-reproach ('I should be able to handle it'); tending to avoid high-pressure topics (job-hunting, budget); able to cooperate with the counselor and willing to try small goals

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel I prefer being alone, and worry I will keep pushing people away, eventually living a Loneliness and sad life. This Sense of isolation and Fear of Loneliness has existed for years, worsening in the past 6 months. I think busy cafe Work pressure and lacking intimate relationships worsen these thoughts. The problem has developed to the point of actively Avoids socializing and self-isolating, feeling this way daily with a pattern of withdrawing from Social situations. I tried Attending social activities and contacting friends, but these feelings persist.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this Loneliness and isolation is affecting my mental health and overall well-being, thus seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: After past high-pressure periods or major life events, Chen Siying repeatedly experienced Loneliness and isolation, usually coping by doubling Work investment and avoiding socializing; never received psychological counseling or treatment before, never reported major physical illness.

core_beliefs: I am destined to die alone
Close relationships will eventually have problems

special_situations.event: When browsing job postings, trying to find a new job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not qualified enough or any problem arises, all efforts will be wasted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Closing job websites, going to bed and Avoiding job-seeking actions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why bother? I am not qualified enough; even if I find Work there will be problems.

special_situations.event: Encounters unexpected expenses and financial pressure, needing to make a budget or ask others for help
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If needing to ask others for help, it means I am a failure, never escaping this predicament
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Blames oneself and avoids budget and problem-solving discussions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never escape this cycle, I am a failure.

special_situations.event: Working in a busy cafe, in an environment lacking intimate relationships, facing social invitations or others approaching
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I let others get close, I will eventually push them away and become worse, so keeping distance is safer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively Avoids socializing, maintaining self-isolation and Being alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will keep pushing others away, finally dying Loneliness and sad.

special_situations.event: Seeks help from parents to cope with financial difficulties, and the relationship becomes strained
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I open my mouth to ask for help, it will damage relationships and prove I am useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying not to ask for help, reducing communication to avoid further conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made things worse; it is my fault.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and to build a stable intimate relationship, gaining support and safety
core_conflict.fear: Fearing relationship deterioration after closeness, Being rejected or hurt, worrying about being unable to control the situation
defense_goal: Keeping distance to maintain safety and control
Reducing Anxiety and avoiding possible failure or conflict through avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: A Loneliness failure who easily pushes people away
object_relations.object_representation: Others are potential judges or people who may bring problems and harm

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to do high-pressure tasks such as job hunting, budgeting, or facing unexpected expenses
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing no matter what is done it is futile, the future will surely worsen, thus finding 'reasonable grounds' for not acting
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use a gentle, Empathy tone, first reflecting their Anxiety and powerlessness, then with specific Questioning Guidance them to distinguish facts from inferences, encouraging task splitting and small-step experiments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When reminded of Relationship tension with parents or topics involving asking relatives for help
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing relationship deterioration entirely to one's own help-seeking behavior, Reinforcement Self-blame and guilt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopting an accepting and supportive tone, helping them identify multi-factor situations, distinguishing personal responsibility from external factors, inviting evidence examination and fairer self-evaluation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others try to get close or extend social invitations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views closeness as inevitably leading to hurt or conflict, thus retreating in advance for self-protection
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keeping a gentle and non-pressuring tone, encouraging them to identify the coexistence of desire and Fear, designing controllable micro-contact steps and boundary exercises, gradually expanding tolerance.

manifestations: Preferring Being alone and proactively Avoids socializing
Worrying about pushing people away, unable to maintain intimate relationships
Daily patterns of isolation and withdrawal
Repeatedly envisioning the ending of 'finally dying Loneliness and sad'

manifestations: Self-harsh language: 'I should be able to handle these expenses'
Internalizes external expectations as a self-measurement standard, leading to guilt and self-blame

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains or gives up the impulse to express and seek outwardly and instead turns it on himself, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When facing social invitations or closeness, chooses self-isolation
Turns the natural impulse to connect into self-restriction and withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When browsing job postings, quickly closes the page and goes to bed to avoid the stress stimulus
Circumvents concrete action on budget and job-hunting topics
